For tolerating a taint, I need to add a `tolerations` section in the pod spec with:

tool_calls.name: write_file
tool_calls.arguments:
{"path":"deployment-app.yaml","content":"apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.31.5
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
      tolerations:
      - key: "dedicated"
        operator: "Equal"
        value: "gpu"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
"}
